video_title: Instagram paid partnership post with TOSSWARE
evidence: CollabFeed tracks lifewiththewilsonfam's August 6, 2026 Instagram post as a paid TOSSWARE creator partnership. TOSSWARE sells physical reusable/recyclable drinkware and party supplies. TOSSWARE's official FAQ explicitly invites collaborations and publishes partnerships@tossware.com for collaboration inquiries. TOSSWARE and tossware.com returned no matches in the permanent GitHub sponsor repo before staging.
